id.desc: ID of the usergroup to add users to

users.desc: The encoded user IDs to add to the usergroup, provided as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. _Maximum:_ `15000`

desc: Add members to an existing organizational usergroup. This method is only available to Enterprise Grid organizations.

errors.cannot_modify_role_admin: The user does not have permission to modify the roles admin role.
errors.feature_not_enabled: The Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this workspace.
errors.invalid_usergroup: A usergroup with the specified ID does not exist.
errors.invalid_users: One or more users provided can not be added to the usergroup.
errors.member_count_would_exceed_visible_limit: The usergroup is visible and the member count would exceed the limit.
errors.not_an_enterprise: The token passed in does not belong to an Enterprise organization.
errors.restricted_action: The calling user cannot modify the specified usergroup, or the usergroup's membership is managed by an identity provider (IdP) and can only be changed through SCIM.
errors.user_not_found: One or more users provided are invalid or are not a member of the organization.
